name: Ondas em Direto, Praia da Rocha (AEMTG)
owner: Agrupamento de Escolas Manuel Teixeira Gomes, with Câmara Municipal de Portimão
how: One GET of the operator's camera page an hour (sources/cams/collect.mjs): up, down or page up without a player. The page's bytes are dropped; no frame, snapshot or stream is ever fetched. Shown by link to the operator's page.

why.basis: A public school group's own page, linked from cm-portimao.pt and carrying the municipality's logo; no terms page found. Flagged: the page does not name the camera; to confirm with the operator.
